text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Facilità... I can feel it... the warmth of 
the sunlit spot...

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
The continuous white suoni are, yes... 
just like a dreaming agnellino.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
The veil drawn by the arpeggio is an 
irresistible... slumber.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
"It is calling me... This melody... is the 
musica of the futon..."

It seems Sounds of Earth is weighed down 
by race fatigue. We might need to rethink 
our schedule.
